scope: Author-approved n=11 GSE80178 raw-CEL sensitivity excluding only GSM2114233

dataset.independence_unit: one source-reported specimen/participant unit per GSE80178 accession
dataset.gse68183_rule: accession-alias provenance only; never read as independent M03 expression input

preprocessing.control_probe_policy: RMA core transcript-cluster target defines retained features

annotation.ambiguous_feature_policy: Retain in feature-level tables but exclude from gene aggregation unless exactly one nonmissing ENTREZID is mapped
annotation.multiple_features_per_gene_policy: Median normalized log2 expression across unambiguously mapped core transcript clusters before gene-level modeling
annotation.missing_annotation_policy: Retain feature-level result with missing gene fields; exclude from gene-level aggregation

model.covariate_rationale: No source-verified participant covariates or batch variables are available for a stable 12-array model
model.blocking: NONE; each retained GSE80178 participant unit contributes one array

contrasts.interpretation: ulcerated diabetic foot tissue versus nonulcerated diabetic foot skin
ulcerated diabetic foot tissue versus healthy nondiabetic foot skin
illustrates distortion from merging biologically distinct control classes; never substitutes for either primary contrast
diabetes-associated difference in nonulcerated foot skin

multiplicity.family: all tested features or genes within each declared contrast
multiplicity.primary_outputs: complete effect-size, standard-error, moderated-statistic, raw-P, and adjusted-P tables

quality_control.outlier_policy: This manifest is the prospectively author-approved sensitivity exclusion of GSM2114233 only. No runtime or automatic exclusion is allowed. Global minimum correlation and annotation yield are diagnostics rather than automatic rejection.

execution_control.intermediate_hash_policy: No repeated hashing; verify inputs once and hash final deliverable outputs once

forbidden_operations: read GSE68183 CEL files as independent evidence
pool DFS and NFS as the primary comparator
include GSE199939 in the core analysis
directly pool raw expression across datasets or platforms
any exclusion other than the prospectively locked GSM2114233 sensitivity exclusion
overwrite any source, prior run, or accepted result
declared_tolerance: Exact hashes, accessions, CEL members, group counts, model formulas, package major/minor versions, and zero source modifications
